parts.problem_md:
Joe posts a link to the shows on an online community.

Anonymity is a threat to the safety of members of online communities.

(i) State** one other** threat to members of online communities.

(1)

(ii) Describe **one **way that moderators can improve the safety of online communities.

(2)
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> (i) Any one from:
> 
> - Cyber bullying / trolls / foul language
> - Misrepresentation
> - Disclosure of personal information / data breach
> 
> (ii) A description such as:
> 
> - Monitor posts/users (1) and flag/report/advise/remove/block inappropriate users/posts (1)

parts.problem_md: Which **one** of these should a user do to improve their online safety?

Joe’s use of digital technologies has implications.

Joe’s radio show is available online.

Explain **two **negative environmental **impacts **of this.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Two explanations such as:
> 
> - Increased energy/resource use (1) because devices require electricity/power (1)
> - Increased global warming (1) because of use of fossil fuels (1)
> - Increased use of mining / limited resources (1) because need for (more) digital devices (1)
> - Increased disposal of digital hardware (1) because more updated devices needed to access online services (1)
> - Negative effects on natural water environment/temperature (1) because of increased use of water (for cooling) (1)
> - Habitats can be destroyed (1) because infrastructure needs to be created (1)

choices.label: B

choices.label: C
choices.text_md: Data that must be protected against unlawful processing

choices.label: D

parts.problem_md:
Visitors usually bring a digital device to events at the venue.

The concert venue uses CCTV.

Discuss the legal and ethical implications of the use of digital technologies to monitor an individual’s movements.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Legal implications for venue. Privacy & Data Protection.
> 
> - Provides legal grounds if needing to prove damage/misuse etc.
> - Places legal responsibility on venue.
> - Policies may be required for staff and customers
> - Training and/or specialist staff required
> - Data management may need to be evidenced
> - Possible fines / legal action for breaches
> 
> Ethical implications for venue and visitors:
> 
> - Trust vs protection.
> - Civil liberties vs individual freedom.
> - Nothing to hide argument.

parts.problem_md:
The staff at the venue work online.

Describe **one **method the staff can use to stay safe online.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description such as:
> 
> - Keep your personal information private / block unknown/worrying users (1) so others cannot mimic you / access your information (1)
> - Report suspicious activity (1) which then safeguards other users (1)
> - Choose a secure password / use a firewall / anti-malware (1) to prevent unauthorised access to your account (1)

parts.problem_md:
Discuss the sustainability issues related to ICT.

You should consider these aspects of digital devices in your response:

- manufacture
- use
- disposal
- ways of mitigating their environmental impact.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> - The manufacture of digital devices
> - The use of digital devices
> - The disposal of digital devices
> - Ways of mitigating the environmental impact of digital devices.
> 
> **For consideration at STP: **
> 
> Renewables, recycle, reuse, remanufacture, ICT systems used for data collection and analysis about energy consumption to support sustainability, ICT for monitoring, sustainability laws and rules, strategies based on decisions made using ICT, carbon footprint, compliance, education/training of decision makers

parts.problem_md:
Camille uses digital devices for work.

GPS can be used to monitor people’s movements.

State **one other** way of monitoring people’s movements.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any one from:
> 
> - Social media
> - Transaction tracking
> - CCTV
> - Mobile phone network / triangulation
> 
> **Accept**: Accelerometer / motion sensor (in a smartphone / smartwatch / pedometer / wearable fitness device etc.)

parts.problem_md:
Camille shares family photographs online with friends.

Which **one **of these is a reason to use an avatar?

Camille’s child, Sarah, uses websites and video sharing sites for her school work.

State **one **way of reducing the environmental impact of the use of servers that host online services.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any one from:
> 
> - They could use renewable energy
> - Put them in colder countries/locations
> - Do not ‘autoplay’ video content in web pages.

parts.problem_md:
Camille designs controllers for a games console.

Explain **one **way of staying safe online.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A linked explanation such as:
> 
> - Limit how much information you put online / use privacy settings (1) because then other users cannot see your location / use information maliciously (1)
> - Block malicious users (1) because then they cannot access your/your friends’ information (1)
> - Report malicious users (1) because this protects others from risk (1)
> - Install firewall / anti-malware / use secure (https) sites / VPN (1) because it protects access to personal information (1)
> - Do not make friends with strangers (1) because people can misrepresent who they are online (1)
> 
> **Do not accept**: responses related to safety of the devices
